review.title: Check this before you save
review.description:
{summary}

Nothing is controlled until you turn on "Coordinator enable" and each room's enable switch. MXZ owns each head's mode while a room is enabled. It puts a head back if it's knocked off the coordinated mode. Turn a room's "Fan auto" switch off to hold your own fan speed. To stop MXZ, turn that room's enable switch off, or turn "Coordinator enable" off for everything.

data_description.engage_deadband: How far a room can drift from target before its head starts again. A room's own drift number overrides this.
data_description.demand_threshold: How far off target a room must be before the whole system switches between heating and cooling. Higher means fewer switches.
data_description.resting_mode_bias: The mode the system waits in when every room is at target.

data_description.mode_hysteresis: Protects the compressor. 600 seconds (10 minutes) is recommended.

data_description.fan_boost_enable: Runs the fan faster the further a room is from target, then eases off. Recommended.
data_description.fan_boost_max: Lower this if High is too loud for a bedroom.
data_description.idle_action: Fan only keeps air moving. Off stops the fan and closes the vanes. Off after drying runs the fan for a while after cooling, then turns off, which helps prevent a musty smell.
data_description.coil_dry_minutes: Used only by Off after drying. Heating skips it.

shared_mode_legacy_option.title: Shared mode no longer offers "{stored}"
shared_mode_legacy_option.description:
Shared mode now offers only the two directions one outdoor unit can share: cool and heat. Arbitration resolved the stored "{stored}" to cool, so it was an unreliable stop control rather than a stop: with the coordinator running it could park a head that had been heating, and while the coordinator was disabled or held in a fixed-mode standby park it was simply retained on the selector. Shared mode now reads "{current}". The stored value does not say which direction the system had been running, nothing else changed, and no hold was created.

To stop the coordinator and leave the heads exactly where they are, turn off **Coordinator enable**. To hold the heads, use the standby hold (Configure → Standby hold → "Hold signal"): its default eco action still conditions a room that reaches the protection extremes, while its off or fan only action parks every head for as long as the hold lasts. To idle one room, turn off that room's enable switch. To stop a satisfied head's fan, set "When a room reaches target" to "Off" (Configure → Fan and idle).

Dismiss this message once you have read it.
